agent_responses.response_str:
Here is our official **Return & Exchange Policy**, now saved to `./output/return_policy.md` for your records. Here's a summary of the key points:

---

### 🔄 Returns (Delivered Orders Only)
- Only orders with **"delivered"** status can be returned.
- You'll need to confirm the **order ID** and the **list of items** to return.
- Refund must go to either the **original payment method** or an **existing gift card**.
- After confirmation, the status changes to **"return requested"** and you'll receive return instructions by email.

### 🔁 Exchanges (Delivered Orders Only)
- Only **delivered** orders can be exchanged.
- Items can be swapped for a different **variant of the same product** (e.g., different size/color — but not a different product type).
- You must provide a payment method for any **price difference**; gift cards must have sufficient balance.
- After confirmation, the status changes to **"exchange requested"** and instructions are emailed — no need to place a new order.
- Exchange can only be done **once per order**, so make sure to list all items you want to exchange at once.

### ❌ Cancellations (Pending Orders Only)
- Only **pending** orders can be cancelled.
- Acceptable reasons: **"no longer needed"** or **"ordered by mistake"** (no other reasons accepted).
- Refund is **immediate** for gift cards, or **5–7 business days** for other payment methods.

### ✏️ Modifications (Pending Orders Only)
- You can modify the **shipping address**, **payment method**, or **product item options** on pending orders.
- Item modifications can only be done **once per order** — after which the order can no longer be modified or cancelled.
- Payment method changes require a different method from the original; gift cards must cover the full total.

### 💳 Refund Timelines
| Payment Method | Refund Timeline |
|---|---|
| **Gift Card** | Immediate |
| **Credit Card / PayPal** | 5–7 business days |

---
